name: JW Marriott Los Ángeles LA LIVE
positioning: JW Marriott Los Angeles L.A. LIVE, a downtown Los Angeles hotel steps from the L.A. LIVE entertainment district, with a rooftop pool deck and an onsite Ritz-Carlton Spa
best_for: Travelers heading to concerts, games or events at Crypto.com Arena, Peacock Theater or the Los Angeles Convention Center
Guests who want a rooftop pool and a full-service spa in downtown Los Angeles

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the L.A. LIVE entertainment district in downtown Los Angeles.
The hotel is within walking distance of Crypto.com Arena, Peacock Theater and the Los Angeles Convention Center.
The GRAMMY Museum is just steps from the hotel's doors.
The hotel is about 10 minutes from Dodger Stadium and the LA Memorial Coliseum, and about 20 minutes from SoFi Stadium.
Griffin suites have an expansive bedroom and a separate living area.
The spa is inspired by the glamour of Hollywood's Golden Age.
The spa's wellness areas include locker rooms, a steam room, a cold shower and a co-ed Sanctuary.
In-room spa amenities can be delivered, including smart goggles, an infrared blanket and a mini-fridge with skincare essentials.
Guests can pre-book custom decor in their guest room for a birthday, anniversary or engagement.
At Volante, eight seats curve around a crescent counter facing a show kitchen.
Savoca, a Californian trattoria, uses regionally sourced ingredients and serves in an open-air atrium space.
The hotel is LEED New Construction certified.

highlights.text: The fourth-floor rooftop pool deck is open year-round, with a heated pool, hot tub, private cabanas and a sun patio looking out over the Los Angeles cityscape and L.A. LIVE.
The hotel has an onsite Ritz-Carlton Spa offering a full range of treatments and services.
Guest rooms feature redwood accents and brushed bronze finishes balanced with warm, neutral tones.
Rooms offer views of the downtown skyline, the L.A. LIVE entertainment district and the surrounding Hollywood Hills.
The hotel grows fresh produce and herbs in its own JW Garden on the fourth floor, used in its recipes and cocktails.

considerations.text: The hotel charges a destination fee, and its inclusions are subject to change.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the business district location has limited residential neighborhood atmosphere.
